description: Changes a playlist's title, description or privacy, and/or replaces its whole song list with `songs` (to reorder or remove songs: send the full new list, using the video ids from get_playlist). Each change is saved as a new version (see playlist_history). Each song is a {"id": "<YouTube video id>"} object (preferred: free and exact) or an "Artist - Title" string, looked up on YouTube (slow, and limited per hour). Reuse the video ids returned by search_songs and earlier calls instead of looking songs up again. Title, description and privacy: owner only (API key, or edit_token for anonymous playlists). Songs: also anyone, for open playlists.

edit_token.description: The edit_token create_playlist returned for an anonymous playlist (made without an API key). Not needed for your own account's playlists.

playlist.description: The playlist's id ("abc123" or "username/abc123") or its great.dj link

private.description: true: only the owner can edit it; false: anyone can

songs.description: The new full list, replacing the current one. Each song is a {"id": "<YouTube video id>"} object (preferred: free and exact) or an "Artist - Title" string, looked up on YouTube (slow, and limited per hour). Reuse the video ids returned by search_songs and earlier calls instead of looking songs up again. At most 500.

name: update_playlist

edit_token.description: Anonymous playlists only: needed to edit it later. Can't be recovered.

owner.description: Username, or null for anonymous playlists

private.description: Only its owner can edit it (anyone with the link can listen)

id.description: YouTube video id: reuse it instead of the title

unmatched.description: Songs that weren't found on YouTube (not added)

title: Update a playlist
